title: iced-mcp flow
description: A recorded path through an iced app, replayed as a regression test by `flow_run` / `iced-mcp run-flow`.

$schema.description: Editors validate against this; `schema/flow.v1.json` in iced-mcp-server.

fixture.description:
The fixture (a named app state, see `fixtures`) loaded before the
first step: an end-to-end flow starts the app in it, a fragment
loads it into the connected app. It makes the flow independent of
whatever ran before.

launch.description: How to start the app, for an end-to-end flow.

prerequisite.description: What must be true before a fragment runs.

action.description: One of [`STEP_ACTIONS`]; `args` are that tool's parameters.
